name: BLEFly
subtitle: BLEFly wing controller builds
description: Unsigned iOS builds of the BLEFly bionic butterfly controller, for sideloading with SideStore.

apps.name: BLEFly Controller
apps.subtitle: BLE wing controller for the bionic butterfly
apps.localizedDescription: Connects to the BLEFly ESP32 over Bluetooth LE and streams 2-byte [steer, throttle] packets to the wing servos.

versions.localizedDescription: Holds full throttle properly — the app now keeps streaming the current stick position, so the craft no longer drops to glide after ~2 flaps. Landscape dual-slider layout, live RSSI bars, unsigned for SideStore.

Landscape dual-slider layout (throttle + steering), live RSSI bars, unsigned for SideStore. Keeps streaming the current stick position, so holding full throttle no longer trips the craft's stale-link failsafe.
